stdout: (no config - demo: an invented seed-stage company, with a previous run for comparison)
MATURITY 37/100 - SCATTERED (Seed)
Capable tactics that are not yet a system. The fastest gains come from connecting them, not adding more.
At seed, a repeatable demand engine and a site that converts are where focus pays back fastest.
DIMENSIONS
Positioning & Messaging     78  Established  answers Fully / Mostly / Mostly  (+22 since last run)
Audience & Demand           44  Emerging     answers Mostly / Partly / Partly  (+11 since last run)  [stage focus]
Website & Conversion        44  Emerging     answers Mostly / Mostly / Not yet  (+11 since last run)  [stage focus]
Sales & Pipeline            22  Scattered    answers Partly / Partly / Not yet
Retention & Expansion       11  Scattered    answers Partly / Not yet / Not yet
Measurement & Economics     22  Scattered    answers Partly / Not yet / Partly  (-11 since last run)
WEAK LINKS - fix in this order
1. Retention & Expansion (11): Growth leaks out the back. Without retention and expansion, every new customer costs more than it should.

Move: This is where the math compounds: map onboarding and the top churn drivers. Skills: onboarding-activation, lifecycle-and-retention, email-lifecycle-sequence. Evidence to check: NRR and GRR for the last twelve months and a coded list of churn reasons.
2. Sales & Pipeline (22): Without a visible, qualified pipeline, the forecast is a guess and the message flies blind.
Move: Make the number defensible. Skills: sales-process-design, pipeline-and-forecast, win-loss-analysis. Evidence to check: a written stage definition and last quarter's forecast against actual.
3. Measurement & Economics (22): Decisions are running on opinion, not evidence: hard to defend and easy to waste.

Move: Instrument before you scale. Skills: unit-economics, marketing-report, incrementality-and-mmm. Evidence to check: CAC, LTV and payback figures from the last quarter, and the date of the last metrics review.
CHANGE since previous run: overall +6
- Measurement & Economics 33 -> 22. A score can fall because the bar rose (you learned what "Fully" means) or because something lapsed; say which.
Not a benchmark: the bands are AAJ's thresholds, and the score is only as honest as the answers.
